name: drawing-scale-game
description: Technical foundation for an online multiplayer drawing game.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@drawing-game/shared && npm run build --workspace=@drawing-game/server && npm run build --workspace=@drawing-game/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@drawing-game/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@drawing-game/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@drawing-game/client && tsc --project tsconfig.json
scripts.format: biome format --write client/src client/index.html client/package.json client/tsconfig.json client/vite.config.ts server/src server/test client/test server/package.json server/tsconfig.json shared/src shared/package.json shared/tsconfig.json scripts e2e playwright.config.ts .github package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json
scripts.format:check: biome format client/src client/index.html client/package.json client/tsconfig.json client/vite.config.ts server/src server/test client/test server/package.json server/tsconfig.json shared/src shared/package.json shared/tsconfig.json scripts e2e playwright.config.ts .github package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json
scripts.lint: biome lint client/src server/src server/test client/test shared/src scripts e2e playwright.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.test:unit: npm run build --workspace=@drawing-game/shared && node --import tsx --import ./scripts/register-test-loaders.mjs --test server/test/*.test.ts client/test/*.test.ts client/test/*.test.tsx
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build --workspace=@drawing-game/shared && c8 node --import tsx --import ./scripts/register-test-loaders.mjs --test server/test/*.test.ts client/test/*.test.ts client/test/*.test.tsx && node scripts/coverage-report.mjs
